verdict.rationale: Penpot's own docs present an official Penpot MCP server that is agent- and LLM-agnostic, can be self-deployed, and is designed so you can 'choose your agent, connect to Penpot MCP and prompt away'. A probe confirms the official MCP server page exists. The evidence is mostly marketing-level, though. Missing for 10: detailed setup/tool reference documentation (transports, exposed tools, auth flow), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect Penpot with any AI agent, any LLM. Penpot MCP server is agnostic and enables high-quality multi-directional AI workflows through our world-class open plugin API.
Choose your agent, connect to Penpot MCP and prompt away!
Deploy the MCP server in your own environment without relying on third-party clouds.
official MCP server documented at https://penpot.dev/ai/mcp-server
